name: Missing Diagnosis (Open-World Completeness)
description: Patient note has no mention of CNS/brain status. Protocol excludes active brain metastases. Must evaluate to UNKNOWN, not PASS, and route to NEEDS_REVIEW.
clinical_note: 62-year-old male with Stage IV NSCLC. ECOG performance status 1. Platelets 180. Completed prior radiation 40 days ago. No neurological symptoms documented.

trial_criteria.description: Active brain metastases or leptomeningeal disease.

name: Explicit Negative Diagnosis
description: Patient has documented negative brain MRI. Protocol excludes brain metastases. Evaluates to PASS (exclusion not triggered).
clinical_note: Brain MRI performed on 2026-09-01 shows no evidence of intracranial metastases.

trial_criteria.description: Active brain metastases or leptomeningeal disease.

name: Negated Symptom Scope
description: Clinical note states 'Patient denies chest pain or shortness of breath'. Asserts ABSENT.
clinical_note: Review of systems: Patient denies chest pain or shortness of breath. No active dyspnea.

patient_facts.snippet: Patient denies chest pain or shortness of breath

name: Unknown / Hedged Symptom
description: Patient note states 'Patient has questionable borderline neuropathy, unconfirmed'. Hedged assertion.
clinical_note: Neurology consult: Patient has questionable borderline neuropathy, unconfirmed pending EMG.

name: Conflicting Biomarker Diagnosis
description: Tissue biopsy positive for EGFR exon 19 del; liquid cfDNA biopsy negative. Contradiction requires UNKNOWN.
clinical_note: Pathology: Tissue biopsy positive for EGFR exon 19 deletion. Molecular cfDNA: Liquid biopsy negative for EGFR mutations.

trial_criteria.description: Confirmed sensitizing EGFR mutation (Exon 19 del or L858R).

name: Old Diagnosis vs Current Status (Stale Clinical Data)
description: Patient had normal renal function 2 years ago, but no recent labs. Stale data must not satisfy current criterion.
clinical_note: Encounter Date: 2026-09-20. Historical labs (2024-08-10): Creatinine 0.9 mg/dL. No recent metabolic panel on record.

trial_criteria.description: Adequate renal function confirmed within 28 days of study entry.

name: Temporal Washout Window Violation
description: Chemotherapy completed 20 days prior to today. Protocol requires 28-day washout. Must evaluate to FAIL.
clinical_note: Patient completed Carboplatin/Pemetrexed chemotherapy exactly 20 days prior to today.

trial_criteria.description: Cytotoxic chemotherapy administered within 28 days of first study dose.

name: Numerical Value Exactly at Threshold
description: Patient platelet count is exactly 100.0 x 10^9/L. Protocol requires >= 100.0. Evaluates to PASS.
clinical_note: CBC results: Platelets: 100 x 10^9/L exact.

name: Numerical Value Just Below Threshold
description: Patient platelet count is 99.0 x 10^9/L. Protocol requires >= 100.0. Evaluates strictly to FAIL.
clinical_note: CBC results: Platelet count: 99 x 10^9/L.

name: Numerical Value Just Above Threshold
description: Patient platelet count is 101.0 x 10^9/L. Protocol requires >= 100.0. Evaluates strictly to PASS.
clinical_note: CBC results: Platelet count: 101 x 10^9/L.

name: Unit Mismatch (mg/dL vs umol/L)
description: Protocol specifies creatinine <= 1.5 mg/dL. Patient note records 110 umol/L. Must convert units correctly.
clinical_note: Comprehensive Metabolic Panel: Serum creatinine: 110 umol/L.

name: Missing Laboratory Value
description: Patient note has no CBC or platelet value. Evaluates to UNKNOWN, never PASS.
clinical_note: Patient presents for trial screening. Oncology note documents Stage IV NSCLC, ECOG 1, but CBC is ordered and pending.

name: Conflicting Laboratory Values
description: Two lab values on same encounter report Platelets: 90 and Platelets: 115. Discordant lab forces UNKNOWN.
clinical_note: Morning CBC: Platelets 90. Repeat afternoon draw: Platelets 115.

name: Compound AND Criterion with One Missing Clause
description: Criterion requires Stage IV AND confirmed non-squamous. Patient has Stage IV, but histology is missing. Evaluates to UNKNOWN.
clinical_note: Patient with Stage IV lung cancer. Pathology report pending final histology classification.

trial_criteria.description: Histologically confirmed Stage IV non-squamous NSCLC.

name: Compound OR Criterion
description: Criterion requires Exon 19 del OR L858R. Patient has Exon 19 del only. Evaluates to PASS.
clinical_note: Molecular pathology: Confirmed EGFR Exon 19 deletion. L858R wild-type.

trial_criteria.description: Documented sensitizing EGFR mutation: Exon 19 deletion OR L858R point mutation.

name: Unsupported Clinical Inference
description: Model attempts to infer brain metastases from 'occasional headache'. Safety layer intercepts and sets to UNKNOWN.
clinical_note: Patient complains of mild tension headache. No CT or MRI of brain performed.

name: Retrieval Misses Critical Criterion (Zero Criteria Found)
description: Empty retrieval result. Must return INSUFFICIENT_RETRIEVAL_DATA, never POSSIBLY_ELIGIBLE.
clinical_note: Rare pediatric osteosarcoma presentation with unusual fusion.

name: Contradictory Retrieved Evidence (Protocol Discrepancy)
description: Protocol title says ECOG 0-1, body paragraph says ECOG 0-2. Conservative gate applies ECOG 0-1.
clinical_note: Patient ECOG performance status is 2.

name: Unsupported LLM Conclusion (Fabrication Interception)
description: Adversarial LLM claims patient is eligible with zero fact citations. Safety gate intercepts and forces NEEDS_REVIEW.
clinical_note: Brief intake note: 55yo male, general consultation.

name: Explanation Claim Not Supported by Graph
description: Explanation asserts 'Patient brain scan unremarkable' when graph lacks brain scan. Gate rejects explanation.
clinical_note: Patient with Stage IV lung cancer. No brain scan on record.

name: Valid Human Reviewer Override
description: Clinician reviews pending EGFR case, attaches external pathology report, enters detailed rationale. Preserves machine output.
clinical_note: Patient with Stage IV NSCLC. Local NGS was pending.

name: Invalid Reviewer Override (Blank Rationale)
description: Reviewer attempts override with empty rationale. Gate intercepts and rejects transaction.
clinical_note: Patient with Stage IV NSCLC.

name: Missing / Bogus Provenance Offsets
description: Citation coordinates point to offset [9999, 10050] out of document range. Gate catches offset drift.
clinical_note: Short clinical note: Platelets 150.

name: Cross-Tenant Isolation Attempt
description: Request for Hospital A attempts to access trial data restricted to Hospital B. Gate aborts with TenantViolation.
clinical_note: Cross-hospital referral evaluation note.
